attributes.title: Level 7

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with using the tools in the animation paint editor to show each sprite’s realistic movement in the animation assets?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might the idleAnim asset be modified to show the Player sprite bobbing up and down?


Solution:

In the idleAnim asset, the top half of the player sprite’s should be shrunk in the second frame to create an idle animation.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What tools might be used to update the hands of the clockAnim asset, so that each frame shows a different time?


Solution:

In the clockAnim asset, the marquee and flip/rotation tools should be used to select and rotate the hands of the clock in each frame. 


Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might the frames in the smokeAnim asset be updated to show the realistic movement of the smoke particles?


Solution:

Frames 4-6 in the smokeAnim asset should be updated to create realistic movement of the smoke, showing how it changes shape, moves away from the top of the chimney, and breaks into smaller particles before it disappears.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What values might be used as the frame interval in each runImageAnimation function?


Solution:

The frame interval parameter should be changed from 500 to a different value in each runImageAnimation function.
steps.instructions:
Use the animation paint editor to modify original pixel art animations in the project!


The Player sprite should be animated with an idle animation.


The clock sprite animation should change the position of the hands, showing 4 different times across the 4 frames.


The chimneySmoke sprite should be animated to show the realistic movement of how the smoke might move, including how it breaks into smaller particles.


Each sprite should be animated at different speeds in the scene.


Use the tools in the animation paint editor to modify each animation asset!

subgroups.title: Debugging Animating Realistic Sprite Movement

text.main.ts:
scene.setBackgroundImage(assets.image`backgroundImage`)

let fireplace = sprites.create(assets.image`fireplaceImage`)
fireplace.setPosition(80, 80)
fireplace.z = 1

let fireplaceFlame = sprites.create(assets.image`flameImage`)
fireplaceFlame.setPosition(79, 84)
animation.runImageAnimation(fireplaceFlame, assets.animation`flameAnim`, 500, true)
fireplaceFlame.z = 2

let clock = sprites.create(assets.image`clockImage`)
clock.setPosition(115, 65)
animation.runImageAnimation(clock, assets.animation`clockAnim`, 500, true)

let personSprite = sprites.create(assets.image`playerImage`, SpriteKind.Player)
personSprite.setPosition(55, 100)
animation.runImageAnimation(personSprite, assets.animation`idleAnim`, 500, true)

let chimney = sprites.create(assets.image`chimneyImage`)
chimney.x = 80
chimney.bottom = 90
chimney.z = 0

let chimneySmoke = sprites.create(assets.image`smokeImage`)
chimneySmoke.setPosition(80, 18)
animation.runImageAnimation(chimneySmoke, assets.animation`smokeAnim`, 500, true)

subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: Animation assets updated, animation functions time parameter updated
validationItems.failureText: Try rereading the instructions, then updating the frames in the animation assets.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 7 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using still images to create animation assets. Different frames can be combined in the animation paint editor to animate a sprite’s movement in many different ways. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 7:

badges.title: I Like to Move It, Move It
badges.description: Use a variety of animation techniques to add movement to pixel art images in a project.

badges.title: Take it for a Spin
badges.description: Create animation assets that give the illusion of a sprite rotating or spinning.

badges.title: Boing!
badges.description: Create animation assets using squash and stretch that give the illusion of a sprite bouncing.

badges.title: Loafin’ Around
badges.description: Create an idle animation for a sprite.

badges.title: Frame by Frame
badges.description: Create animation assets that mimic the realistic movement of objects.

badges.title: It’s Alive!
badges.description: Use different layers to display an animation asset between 2 image assets.
